anf_compare.notes: No published English was consulted; translated from the PG 70 Greek only.

bible_refs.note: Lemma Καὶ ἐγὼ ἔδωκα αὐτοῖς προστάγματα οὐ καλά = LXX Ezekiel 20:25a.
ὁ νόμος ἅγιος καὶ ἡ ἐντολὴ ἁγία καὶ δικαία καὶ ἀγαθή, verbatim.
Δικαιοῦται γὰρ οὐδεὶς ἐν νόμῳ, introduced by κατὰ τὸ γεγραμμένον; Galatians 3:11 reads ἐν νόμῳ οὐδεὶς δικαιοῦται παρὰ τῷ θεῷ (compare Galatians 2:16).
Lemma Ἰδοὺ τὸ γάλα κατεσθίετε = LXX Ezekiel 34:3 (LXX κατέσθετε).
Lemma Καὶ οὐχ ἱκανὸν ὑμῖν ὅτι τὴν καλὴν νομὴν ἐνέμεσθε = LXX Ezekiel 34:18a; the verse's trampled pasture and fouled water are taken up in frag-rem-close.

choices.why: κατευανθέω would mean 'bloom fully', which contradicts the dry tree that God makes sprout; read καταυανθέν, 'dried up'.
Kept apart from ἐντολή ('commandment') in the Romans quotation in the next clause.

choices.term: ἀλλ' οὐδὲ ζωῆς τῆς αἰωνίου πρόξενα
choices.english: indeed they do not even bring eternal life
choices.why: ἀλλ' οὐδέ intensifies ('not even'); πρόξενος here is 'procuring, bringing about'.
rejected: but not even procurers of eternal life

choices.term: ταῖς ἐκ λαῶν δωροφορίαις ... τῆς σωτηρίας αὐτῶν
choices.english: the gifts the people brought ... the people's salvation
choices.why: λαοί here is the lay people of Israel, the neglected flock; 'the peoples' would read as the Gentile nations.
rejected: the gift-bringings of the peoples ... their salvation

edition.locus: Frag remainder, middle ('greedy encroachments' to 'the finest pasture…')

lemmas.gloss: dry up, wither (read for codex κατευανθέν)

pass_a_gloss: [continuing: the dry tree, the Church from the nations, by the devil's] greedy overreachings (πλεονεξίαις) withered (κατευανθέν, the codex reading, read as καταυανθέν 'dried up') [so the codex]. Lemma: and I gave to them ordinances (προστάγματα) not good [Ezekiel 20:25]. [Cat. 210b] For as far as it reached toward spiritual contemplation (θεωρίαν), the law holy and the commandment holy and just and good. As far as indeed toward the futility (εἰκαιότητα) of the thing and the only worship in shadows, not good the ordinances, but not even of life eternal procurers. For is justified no one in law, according to the written. Lemma: behold the milk you devour [Ezekiel 34:3]. [Cat. f. 224] For demanding according to the law tithes, firstfruits, thank offerings, and in the gift-bringings (δωροφορίαις) from peoples luxuriating prodigally, of none of their salvation they made account. Lemma: and not sufficient for you that the good pasture you were grazing [Ezekiel 34:18]? [Cat. f. 224b] For law-learned (νομομαθεῖς) being, those from the blood of Levi, and a most beautiful as it were pasture [sentence continues in frag-rem-close].
pass_b_english: “And I gave them ordinances that were not good” (Ezekiel 20:25). For in so far as it bears on spiritual contemplation, the Law is holy, and the commandment is holy and just and good (Romans 7:12). But in so far as it concerns the futility of the practice itself, and worship in shadows alone, the ordinances are not good; indeed they do not even bring eternal life. For no one is justified by the Law, as it is written (Galatians 3:11).

“See, you eat up the milk” (Ezekiel 34:3). For while they demanded tithes, firstfruits, and thank offerings according to the Law, and reveled wantonly in the gifts the people brought, they took no account at all of the people’s salvation.
“Is it not enough for you that you grazed on the good pasture?” (Ezekiel 34:18). For those of the blood of Levi, being learned in the Law, and with, as it were, the finest pasture…

πλεονεξίαις κατευανθέν ita cod. Καὶ ἐγὼ ἔδωκα αὐτοῖς προστάγματα οὐ καλά.
Cat. 210. b. Ὅσον μὲν γὰρ ἧκεν εἰς θεωρίαν πνευματικὴν, ὁ νόμος ἅγιος καὶ ἡ
ἐντολὴ ἁγία καὶ δικαία καὶ ἀγαθή. Ὅσον γε μὲν εἰς τὴν τοῦ πράγματος εἰκαιότητα,
καὶ μόνην τὴν ἐν σκιαῖς λατρείαν, οὐ καλὰ τὰ προστάγματα, ἀλλ' οὐδὲ ζωῆς τῆς
αἰωνίου πρόξενα. ∆ικαιοῦται γὰρ οὐδεὶς ἐν νόμῳ, κατὰ τὸ γεγραμμένον. Ἰδοὺ τὸ
γάλα κατεσθίετε. Cat. f. 224. Ἐξαιτοῦντες γὰρ κατὰ τὸν νόμον δεκάτας, ἀπαρχὰς,
εὐχαριστήρια, καὶ ταῖς ἐκ λαῶν δωροφορίαις ἐντρυφῶντες ἀσώτως, οὐδένα τῆς
σωτηρίας αὐτῶν ἐποιοῦντο λόγον. Καὶ οὐχ ἱκανὸν ὑμῖν ὅτι τὴν καλὴν νομὴν
ἐνέμεσθε; Cat. f. 224. b.
Νομομαθεῖς γὰρ ὄντες οἱ ἐξ αἵματος Λευὶ, καὶ καλλίστην ὥσπερ νομὴν,
reviewer: claude (Wave A review, clause by clause against the Greek)
review_notes: Replaces a scaffold row that held no translation; the English is new, translated from the locked PG 70 Greek in translations/fe_frag_rem_source.json.
Reviewer fix: tense made consistent ('bears on ... is'); 'in so far as it concerns' given its subject; ἀλλ' οὐδέ as 'indeed they do not even'.
Reviewer fix: ἐκ λαῶν as 'the people' (lay Israel), and αὐτῶν made explicit as the people's salvation.
Reviewer fix: title 'Ordinances Not Good' was a calque; now 'Ordinances That Were Not Good, and Greedy Shepherds'.
PG prints κατευανθέν with 'ita cod.'; the sense requires καταυανθέν ('dried up, withered', from καταυαίνω), which the English follows. The source text is left as printed.
Lemmas checked against LXX Ezekiel 20:25, 34:3 and 34:18; Romans 7:12 and Galatians 3:11 checked.
Negations kept: 'not good', 'do not even bring', 'no one is justified', 'took no account at all'.
